alignments.note: Anarthrous substantival participle takes the supplied *He that* (rule 46) and the modal *would* under rule 17; head on the lexeme word. The marginal glosses were read and set aside under rule 38.
Finite verb keeps its own word.
No article morpheme is present, so the supplied *the* joins the noun (rule 15).
Noun keeps its own word; the ASV reorders it after the verb, which rule 25 allows.
*right hand* renders יָמִין; rule 31 heads on *right*, since *hand* alone is any hand.

review_notes: The marginal alternative 'the oil of his right hand betrayeth itself' would restructure the second line entirely; the printed text governs under rule 38 and שֶׁמֶן is aligned as the object of *encountereth*.
Competing head for s007: *hand*, if יָמִין is read as naming the hand with *right* as a specifier; taken on *right* because *hand* alone loses the lexeme.
